strengths: The brief, golden solution, and verifier all target one self-contained /app/index.html artifact.
All graded behavior is stated explicitly and verified through visible browser interactions.
The verifier is deterministic, runs in a separate image, emits binary reward and CTRF output, and makes no LLM calls.
The agent image contains no verifier-only browser or Python tooling.
The task uses the supplied Software / Classic & Board Games taxonomy and the project-default public network mode.

known_review_risks.note: Connect Four is intentionally simple to align with the supplied vanilla Snake task style. A generic reviewer may still reject the familiar concept as insufficiently difficult.
